concept.title: Request Limits
concept.shortdesc: This section describes the request limits.

conbody.p: This section describes the request limits.
ADI OtoSense™ SMS device enforces tenant-level request quota limits.

ul.li: The quota will be quoted for the month, but in practice, it is broken down into an hourly rate.
A sliding 12-hour window is used to create a credit backlog.
Unused request quotas are carried over to the current hour.
If you exceed your hourly request quota, a 429 response will be returned. The Retry-After header of the 429 response includes details on how long to wait before resuming API requests.

conbody.p: See your subscription details for information on your request quotas.
